result.fundName: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth

insights: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth underperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.66% (16.00% vs 16.66%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 51.9% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.70 vs 0.57) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.17, volatility within 7% of the index.
Positive alpha of 11.10% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.13).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -24.65% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans -15.44% to 61.70% (77.14 pp spread) — consistency score 51.
Failed criteria: Rolling Return, Chance of Beating Benchmark.
